name: Esteemed Elders in Every Game
description: A villager who has mastered three or more skills (88 or more) gets the title "Esteemed Elder" on the Villager Details screen even when the game has not made them an Esteemed Elder (the normal game stops making new elders, and their totems, at 50 totems). The normal game's own Esteemed Elders, and their totems, are unchanged; this patch makes no totem. A totem statue never gets the title, and a custom title (Story / Cheat Upgrades) still shows in its place. The logs' "Special villager" line says it too, and when such a villager dies as an adult their grave gets the game's own "Esteemed Elder" epitaph. **Villagers and graves from before: Repair Saves & Logs > "Give the Esteemed Elder title retroactively".** **Works the same with every other patch and in every population mode.** **Not yet seen in a running game** (checked by emulation of the stock executable). The companion is "VVFP Esteemed Elders.dll"; it never writes a save or a file.
behavior_changes: The Villager Details screen's title and an adult's grave epitaph: the game's own "Esteemed Elder" (strings 0x87 and 0x1F0) for a villager with the stock flag +0x7FC, as before, or with three or more of the five skills at 88 or more (never a totem statue, +0x558).
The logs' "Special villager: Esteemed Elder" line follows the same rule while the companion is installed.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion splices its sites at run time, all or none, only after verifying their stock bytes; the game goes on with the registers it reads afterwards as they were.
No skill, flag, totem, job or save field is changed; the rule only reads the villager's record.
The Secret City and New Believers are left as the stock game makes them (their own Esteemed Elder rule).
The stock elder pass (0x44D4C0), its flag, its totems and the Village Elders counter are unchanged.

runtime_detours.routine: the villager panel's elder flag test (`cmp byte [ecx+0x7FC], bl / je 0x429C3D`): the flag, or three or more of the five skills +0x7E4..+0x7F4 at 88 or more (never a totem, +0x558), takes the game's own "Esteemed Elder" (string 0x87, 0x429C25); otherwise the rank at 0x429C3D with every register as it was
runtime_detours.installed_by: VVFP Esteemed Elders.dll, VvfpStartup (started by VVFP More Companions.dll, third word)

runtime_detours.routine: the burial's elder test for an adult's epitaph (`mov al, [ecx+0x7FC] / test al, al / je 0x465172`): the flag, or the same three-mastered rule, takes the game's own epitaph 0x1F0 (0x465146); otherwise the job's epitaph at 0x465172
runtime_detours.installed_by: VVFP Esteemed Elders.dll, VvfpStartup (started by VVFP More Companions.dll, third word)
